Here are ten emojis that could be used to convey the idea of "Both are bad":

1. 🙁 (Frowning Face)
2. 🙊 (Face with Hands Over Mouth)
3. 🤬 (Face with Look of Disgust)
4. 🚫 (No Entry Sign)
5. 💩 (Pile of Poo)
6. 🙃 (Winking Face with Tired Eyes)
7. 🤒 (Face with Thermometer)
8. 🙈 (Face with Hand Over Mouth)
9. 🙉 (Face with Hand Over Mouth and Nose)
10. 🙊 (Face with Both Hands Pressing Cheeks)

These emojis can be used in different contexts to express that two things or situations are both undesirable.
